text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before the February Stakes—the first of her targeted races
where she had declared she'd take first—
a sudden entry was made into the Kawasaki Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Behind that decision lay
Smart Falcon's extraordinary determination—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's my Kawasaki-version pep-up!
There's a velodrome nearby, right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "Just like a bicycle, I'm gonna zoom right ahead! *Vroom*☆"
choice_data_list: (Isn't she fast enough even without riding?)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
choice_data_list: Make sure not to do anything reckless.
Make sure not to do anything reckless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The February Stakes is right around the corner.
It would be wise to avoid a fighting style that drains too much stamina."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry!
Guts are everything for an Umadol, so—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Slipping away before things get out of hand—
that's our Fa-l-co! ☆

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Smart Falcon! She's really blowing up right now.
As a dirt fan, I'm super curious to see how she does.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She's always worked hard, after all.
Personally, I really think Smart Falcon could take on the world.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Going overseas one day... well,
maybe that could be an option too."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: There must be fans waiting for Falco overseas too, right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehe.
Now I'm even more fired up."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All right!
Time to go vrooooom☆!
